info.title: Omnia Voice API v2
info.description:
Build and run voice agents (speech-to-text → language model → text-to-speech) over HTTP.

Same host and the same API keys as the rest of the Omnia Voice API. The key must belong to a
workspace with API v2 enabled. Requests that start calls or campaigns need
credit (402 otherwise). Gateway errors look like `{"error": {"message", "code"}}`; errors
from the engine itself are passed through as problem documents (`code`, `detail`, `errors`).
Model and voice specs use the provider `omnia`.

Newest first. ``q`` searches the call id, phone numbers, agent id and the customer's
name, number, email and external id.

get.description:
A short-lived Omnia token to listen in on a call in progress.

The listener is hidden (neither the caller nor the agent sees it) and cannot publish audio
or data. Connect with the Omnia web SDK using ``server_url`` and ``token`` and play
the audio tracks you receive. ``409 call_ended`` once the call is final.

post.description:
Make the agent say ``text`` now (a ``transcript.item`` event follows).

``409 agent_not_joined`` until the ``call.started`` event; ``409 call_ended`` after.

Steer the agent: it generates its next reply from ``instructions`` right away (for
example "the customer is a VIP, offer the premium plan" or "wrap up the call").

post.description:
Validate an agent definition. Always 200: errors and warnings are in the body.

Secret references are checked against the caller's stored secrets (``missing_secret``,
``secret_scope_denied``, ``secret_host_denied`` errors); inline secret values produce
``inline_secret`` warnings. Stored tool references are checked against the caller's stored
tools.
Convert an OpenAI (chat or Responses) or Anthropic tool to our format and validate it.

post.description:
Store the customers and start dialing (or wait for ``schedule.earliest_at``). Up to
``max_concurrency`` calls run at once; ``retry`` re-dials busy / unanswered customers.
Every call carries ``campaign_id``, the campaign's ``labels`` / ``metadata`` and the
customer as ``customer``.

post.description: Stop placing new calls; calls in progress finish normally.

Cancel every contact not yet dialed (``campaign.completed`` is sent); calls in progress
finish normally.

get.description: The customers of the campaign with their state, attempts and latest call.

put.description: Create a secret, or rotate it to a new version (200). The value is never returned.

delete.description: Delete every version. Calls using the secret fail until it is stored again.

get.description:
Voices available through Omnia, grouped by language and gender.

``language`` takes a base language (``de``: every German locale) or a locale (``en-GB``);
``country`` an ISO 3166 code (``US``). Removed, retired and disabled voices are left out
unless ``include_unavailable=true``. ``limit``/``offset`` page the sorted list before it is
grouped, so groups only cover the page. ``sync`` says how fresh the directory is.
Languages with voice counts (per locale and gender), for a language-first picker.
One voice, including removed or retired ones (``available=false``).

AgentDefinition.title: AgentDefinition
AgentDefinition.description:
Everything that defines an agent, independent of any particular call.

This is what the product app stores (or a customer sends inline). The control plane
combines it with a :class:`CallContext` to produce a :class:`RuntimeConfig`.

AvatarConfig.title: AvatarConfig
AvatarConfig.description:
A virtual avatar (video) that speaks the agent's audio.

Avatars only apply to the web channel: they can be part of any agent definition, and the
worker ignores them on phone calls.

BackgroundAudioConfig.title: BackgroundAudioConfig
BackgroundAudioConfig.description:
Sounds mixed under the agent: ambience loops for the whole call, "thinking" sounds play
while the agent works on a reply. One clip of each list is picked by probability.

Credentials.title: Credentials
Credentials.description:
Bring-your-own provider credentials. Omit to use platform credentials from the worker env.

Only the fields a provider's plugin can actually receive are accepted by the worker; a field
the provider cannot use fails the call setup instead of being silently ignored.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description:
The person a call is with (given when the call is created, echoed on the call resource and
on every webhook delivery as ``data.customer``). Never sent to the model.

anyOf.description: Reference to a stored tenant secret, e.g. {{secrets.CRM_TOKEN}}.

DirectHttpRequest.title: DirectHttpRequest
DirectHttpRequest.description:
The HTTP request a tool makes (the execution target).

Placeholders: ``{{args.name}}`` is a tool argument (filled when the tool runs),
``{{vars.name}}`` a call variable and ``{{call.id|channel|caller_number|called_number}}`` a
call field (both filled when the call is created). ``{{secrets.NAME}}`` references are only
allowed as whole header values and in ``auth``.

DtmfInputConfig.title: DtmfInputConfig
DtmfInputConfig.description: Keypad presses (DTMF) sent to the agent as a user message ``[keypad] 1234``.

EndpointingConfig.title: EndpointingConfig
EndpointingConfig.description:
When a user turn is considered finished.

Every field is optional: an unset field keeps the default, which depends on the turn
detection in use (the end-of-turn model waits less than VAD-only detection). Per-agent
overrides replace only the fields they set.

GenericSipConnectionCreate.title: GenericSipConnectionCreate
GenericSipConnectionCreate.description: Manual setup: the customer configures their carrier with the returned SIP details.

HistoryMessage.title: HistoryMessage
HistoryMessage.description: A prior conversation message the call starts with.

anyOf.description: Reference to a stored tenant secret, e.g. {{secrets.CRM_TOKEN}}.

HmacAuth.title: HmacAuth
HmacAuth.description:
Request signing (proxy mode only).

``timestamp`` is the current Unix time in whole seconds (decimal text). The signature is the
lowercase hex HMAC of ``"{timestamp}.{raw request body}"`` with ``secret`` (the body is the
exact bytes sent; empty for requests without a body). It is sent as ``header: <hex>`` along
with ``timestamp_header: <timestamp>``. Receivers should reject timestamps older than a few
minutes.

InboundNumberSettings.title: InboundNumberSettings
InboundNumberSettings.description: How inbound calls to a phone number are accepted.

ListenTokenResponse.title: ListenTokenResponse
ListenTokenResponse.description: Join the call's call as a hidden, subscribe-only participant to hear it live.

anyOf.description: Reference to a stored tenant secret, e.g. {{secrets.CRM_TOKEN}}.

OAuth2ClientCredentialsAuth.title: OAuth2ClientCredentialsAuth
OAuth2ClientCredentialsAuth.description:
OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant (RFC 6749 §4.4), proxy mode only.

The control plane requests a token from ``token_url`` (form body ``grant_type=
client_credentials`` plus ``scope``/``audience`` when set; client credentials in HTTP Basic
auth, or in the body with ``client_auth="body"``) and sends ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``.
Tokens are cached per tenant, tool and credentials until 60 s before ``expires_in``; a 401
from the tool endpoint drops the cached token and retries once with a new one.

OptionSpec.title: OptionSpec
OptionSpec.description: A provider option settable in a spec's ``options`` (a JSON value).

ParticipantSpec.title: ParticipantSpec
ParticipantSpec.description: The end user joining a web call.

PhoneNumberUpdate.title: PhoneNumberUpdate
PhoneNumberUpdate.description:
Only the given fields change. ``agent_id: null`` unassigns the agent. ``inbound``
replaces all inbound settings (send the full object); ``overrides`` replaces the whole
overrides object (``{}`` clears it).

RealtimeModelConfig.title: RealtimeModelConfig
RealtimeModelConfig.description: Speech-to-speech model (OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, Nova Sonic...).

ResponseMapping.title: ResponseMapping
ResponseMapping.description: What the model sees from a tool response (see :mod:`voice_contracts.tool_response`).

ScheduleSpec.title: ScheduleSpec
ScheduleSpec.description:
When an outbound call may be placed. The call is created with status ``scheduled`` and
dispatched by the API at (or shortly after) ``earliest_at``.

reprompt_instructions.title: Reprompt Instructions
reprompt_instructions.default: The user has gone quiet. Briefly and politely check whether they are still there.

goodbye_message.title: Goodbye Message
goodbye_message.default: It seems we got disconnected. Goodbye!

StructuredExtraction.title: StructuredExtraction
StructuredExtraction.description: One named JSON object the model fills from the conversation.

ToolErrorMessages.title: ToolErrorMessages
ToolErrorMessages.description: What the model is told when the upstream fails (see :mod:`voice_contracts.tool_errors`).

ToolRef.title: ToolRef
ToolRef.description:
A reusable tool stored with ``POST /api/v2/tools``, used from an agent definition.

Agents list it by the stored tool's name. The control plane replaces the reference with the
stored definition (``version``, or the latest version) when a call is created, so the call
snapshot holds a full tool and later edits of the stored tool do not affect it.

ToolUpdateRequest.title: ToolUpdateRequest
ToolUpdateRequest.description: Only the given fields change. A new ``tool`` creates a new immutable version.

TurnDetectorConfig.title: TurnDetectorConfig
TurnDetectorConfig.description:
Tuning of the end-of-turn model (``turn_detection: model``).

One detector is built per call and shared by every agent that uses the model; the settings
are session-wide.

TwilioAccount.title: TwilioAccount
TwilioAccount.description:
Twilio credentials given inline with a number (one-step add). The connection for this
account is created on first use and reused afterwards.

TwilioConnectionCreate.title: TwilioConnectionCreate
TwilioConnectionCreate.description:
Automated setup. Provide ``auth_token``, or ``api_key_sid`` + ``api_key_secret``
(recommended: revocable independently of the account).

UpdateCallRequest.title: UpdateCallRequest
UpdateCallRequest.description:
Change ``labels`` / ``metadata`` of a call in any status (each replaces the whole
object when given).

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.default: The caller has been speaking for a long time without a pause. Politely cut in, briefly summarize what you understood so far and ask one short question to move forward.

VariableSpec.title: VariableSpec
VariableSpec.description:
A call variable, used as ``{{name}}`` in instructions and messages (``{{vars.name}}`` in
HTTP tool requests).

VoiceQueryCredentials.title: VoiceQueryCredentials
VoiceQueryCredentials.description: Bring-your-own credentials for live listing. Never logged or returned.

ApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ApiKey.description: Your Omnia Voice API key (Dashboard → Agent API Keys).
